name: TRIP B - Europe multi-city, Jan 15-27 2027
description: One-way legs, economy, 1 adult on flights / 2 people on hotels. Real cash prices captured by Tsuki on 2026-09-07.
source: Google Flights + Accor/NH/Hilton, captured 2026-09-07 by Tsuki. Transcribed verbatim.
trip_level_flags: HOTEL DATES DO NOT LINE UP WITH THE FLIGHTS. Novotel Madrid and NH City Centre Amsterdam are BOTH booked Jan 15-19 2027, which is impossible - you cannot be in two cities on the same four nights. The flight legs imply Madrid ~Jan 16-19, Amsterdam Jan 19-23, London Jan 23-27. Reported, NOT corrected: the right dates are a decision for Tsuki, not a guess for the optimizer.
Trip A and Trip B both start Jan 15 2027. They appear to be ALTERNATIVES, not one itinerary. Scored separately.
Flights are priced for 1 adult, hotels for 2 people. Nothing has been doubled to reconcile this.
No London hotel dates were given beyond '4 nights'. Assumed to be the Jan 23-27 window implied by the flights, but the booking dates were not captured.

Every Google 'from $X' headline in this capture is LOWER than the cheapest option actually listed beneath it (388 vs 395, 35 vs 44, 450 vs 482). The headline fares were not available in the listing; the listed fares are used.

points_candidates.label: Air Canada SFO-MAD via YUL (badge 50k pts)
points_candidates.source_note: Google Flights '50k pts' badge. CONFIRMED BY SEATS.AERO 2026-09-08: a real SFO-MAD search returned an Aeroplan economy award on 2027-01-15 at exactly 50,000 miles with 9 seats and CAD 44.60 in taxes (tests/fixtures/seats_aero/sfo_mad_real.json). The badge was right on THIS leg - which is a fact about this leg, not a licence to trust badges generally; the other badges in this trip remain unverified. The real response also shows the operating metal is NOT AC alone: it lists AC, LH, UA and VL as possible carriers. Aeroplan's zero surcharge is a program-wide policy and does not depend on the metal, so every one of them resolves to the same $0 and the verdict is unaffected. The CAD 44.60 in taxes is NOT included below - CAD has no configured FX rate, so it is an explicit unknown that can only make the points side worse.
